prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. The ground split open between the tents and water bursting up out of the earth in a white spray, people in silhouette scrambling away, the vast ark, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof, dark on the hill beyond the camp. Night, lightning lighting the spray. Violent and sudden. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
